description: Needs a SpaceNexus API key with SpaceNexus Research. Search announced and reported space raises in progress (intentions, not completed rounds): company, stage, basis (company-says vs reported), stated target amount, verbatim quote and source URL. Filter by sector, stage, basis and target size.

basis.description: Whether stated by the company or reported by a publication.

limit.description: How many raises in progress to return (1 to 25).

min_target_usd.description: Minimum target raise in US dollars.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging (0 to 10000).

show.description: open: active raises only; all: include closed and stale records.

name: raising_now_search
title: Raising now search
